note: A-8 (plan 2026-10-01 §2): how each river icon meets the water after D1 (levels.json RIVER_Y −6.3, RIVERWALK_Y −5.3). Read by pipeline/lib/riverbases.js. Geometry is laid against the river polygon's land edges in front of each building (OSM); explicit points are model metres (shared/project.js, origin State & Madison, +x east, +z south) drawn on the OSM footprints and the river polygon. Layouts not given in a source are read from photographs and marked approximate. 'riverwalk' = RIVERWALK_Y; walk widths and stair positions are approximate.
sources: https://www.chicago.gov/content/dam/city/depts/dcd/supp_info/chicago_river_main_branchframeworkplan.pdf (Chicago River Main Branch Framework Plan: river-level walks along the north bank and the South Branch)
OpenStreetMap (ODbL): building footprints and the river polygon

sites.about: The Wrigley Building's river face: its white terra-cotta base carried down to the water, and the river-level walk along the north bank from the DuSable Bridge's northwest stair toward Trump
sites.note: the terra-cotta glaze matches the building's own row; arcade bays read from photographs (approximate)

sites.about: Trump International Hotel & Tower's public riverwalk: a granite walk at the water below its riverside promenade, with stairs at both ends
sites.note: two-level riverfront (street promenade + river walk); widths read from photographs (approximate)

sites.about: Apple Michigan Avenue: wide stone steps down from Pioneer Court either side of the glass pavilion to a landing at the river; 32 ft glass walls under a thin carbon-fibre roof 111 × 98 ft on slender stainless columns

stepsLand.about: the west steps from Pioneer Court

sites.note: glass walls 32 ft (9.75 m) from the river landing; roof 111 × 98 ft (33.8 × 29.8 m); the steps cascade from Pioneer Court to the river on both sides of the pavilion (Foster + Partners); step widths read from the OSM footprints and photographs (approximate)

sites.about: Marina City's raised platform over its marina: the plaza deck on columns, the towers' cores down to the water, the restaurants at river level under the plaza, a terrace at the water and the boat slips in front
sites.lineNote: OSM maps the marina basin running in under the platform (to z −656); the walk and slips stand at the platform's river edge
sites.note: 'built on a raised platform next to the Chicago River; beneath the platform, at river level, is a small marina' (Wikipedia). Core 35 ft across (approximate); restaurant and slip layout read from OSM (layer −1/−2 restaurants) and photographs (approximate)
